# Stage 6 — Governance Intent: book_library_mgmt / catalog

## Machine

```yaml
document:
  phase: p6
  domain: book_library_mgmt
  subdomain: catalog
  cr: cr_01_catalog
  rule_set: transformation.schemas.REGISTER_SCHEMA_P6_V0
registers:
  ownership:
  - capability: Register a book together with its first physical copy
    owner_subdomain: catalog
    disposition: OWNED
    existing_artifact: ''
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-05}
  - capability: Register a further physical copy against a registered book
    owner_subdomain: catalog
    disposition: OWNED
    existing_artifact: ''
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-06}
  - capability: Update a book's bibliographic information
    owner_subdomain: catalog
    disposition: OWNED
    existing_artifact: ''
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-07}
  - capability: Retire a book record
    owner_subdomain: catalog
    disposition: OWNED
    existing_artifact: ''
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-08}
  - capability: Retire a physical copy
    owner_subdomain: catalog
    disposition: OWNED
    existing_artifact: ''
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-09}
  - capability: Return a retired book record to the registered state
    owner_subdomain: catalog
    disposition: OWNED
    existing_artifact: ''
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-10}
  - capability: Return a retired physical copy to the registered state
    owner_subdomain: catalog
    disposition: OWNED
    existing_artifact: ''
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-11}
  - capability: Search the catalog by subject or title
    owner_subdomain: catalog
    disposition: OWNED
    existing_artifact: ''
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-12}
  - capability: Retrieve a book's complete details with the copies held
    owner_subdomain: catalog
    disposition: OWNED
    existing_artifact: ''
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-13}
  - capability: Confirm the staff member performing an operation is authorized
    owner_subdomain: catalog
    disposition: OWNED
    existing_artifact: ''
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-04}
  - capability: Record every performed catalog operation in the catalog's own audit trail
    owner_subdomain: catalog
    disposition: OWNED
    existing_artifact: ''
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-01}
  - capability: Read every book record so that a search can select among them by content
    owner_subdomain: platform
    disposition: OWNED
    existing_artifact: ''
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-17}
  - capability: Hold a durable record that can be read, listed and updated in place
    owner_subdomain: platform
    disposition: SATISFIED
    existing_artifact: capability_side_effects::CS_MUTABLE_JSON_V0
    source_finding: {phase: p3, register: authoring_decisions, key: Hold a book record durably and update it in place}
  - capability: Claim a value once so a second claim on it fails
    owner_subdomain: platform
    disposition: SATISFIED
    existing_artifact: capability_side_effects::CS_REGISTRY_V0
    source_finding: {phase: p3, register: authoring_decisions, key: 'Enforce that one book exists per title, author and publication year'}
  - capability: Append an entry to a trail that cannot be amended
    owner_subdomain: platform
    disposition: SATISFIED
    existing_artifact: capability_side_effects::CS_APPENDONLY_JSONL_V0
    source_finding: {phase: p3, register: authoring_decisions, key: Append an entry to an append-only trail}
  - capability: Assemble a durable record from supplied values
    owner_subdomain: platform
    disposition: SATISFIED
    existing_artifact: capability_transforms::CT_PURE_ASSEMBLE_RECORD_V0
    source_finding: {phase: p3, register: authoring_decisions, key: Assemble a catalog record from supplied values}
  - capability: Confirm a record carries the fields its contract declares
    owner_subdomain: platform
    disposition: SATISFIED
    existing_artifact: capability_transforms::CT_PURE_VALIDATE_RECORD_STRUCTURE_V0
    source_finding: {phase: p3, register: authoring_decisions, key: Confirm a catalog record carries its required fields}
  - capability: Select the records matching stated criteria
    owner_subdomain: platform
    disposition: SATISFIED
    existing_artifact: capability_transforms::CT_PURE_FILTER_RECORDS_V0
    source_finding: {phase: p3, register: authoring_decisions, key: Select the catalog records matching stated criteria}
  - capability: Confirm supplied parameters satisfy declared rules
    owner_subdomain: platform
    disposition: SATISFIED
    existing_artifact: capability_transforms::CT_PURE_VALIDATE_PARAMETER_RULES_V0
    source_finding: {phase: p3, register: authoring_decisions, key: Confirm the parameters supplied to a catalog operation satisfy their declared rules}
  - capability: Deciding which staff are authorized
    owner_subdomain: staff
    disposition: DEFERRED
    existing_artifact: ''
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: authority_deferrals, row: 1}
  - capability: Deleting a catalog record
    owner_subdomain: catalog
    disposition: DEFERRED
    existing_artifact: ''
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: business_invariants, row: 9}
  storage_governance:
  - storage_need: A durable record of every book the library catalogs
    purpose: The library requires one authoritative description per book, correctable in place, carrying its own registered-or-retired state
    subdomain: catalog
    source_finding: {phase: p5, register: business_objects, key: Book record}
  - storage_need: A durable record of every physical copy the library owns
    purpose: The library requires one authoritative record per copy, each naming the one book it belongs to and carrying its own state
    subdomain: catalog
    source_finding: {phase: p5, register: business_objects, key: Physical copy record}
  - storage_need: A trail of performed operations that cannot be amended
    purpose: Every operation must be traceable afterwards, and a trail that could be rewritten would not be evidence
    subdomain: catalog
    source_finding: {phase: p5, register: business_objects, key: Catalog audit trail}
  - storage_need: A claim on each book's identity, held once
    purpose: Duplicate prevention needs the claim on title, author and publication year to hold at the moment of registration
    subdomain: catalog
    source_finding: {phase: p5, register: business_objects, key: Book identity registry}
  - storage_need: A claim on each copy's barcode, held once
    purpose: No two copies the library owns may carry the same barcode
    subdomain: catalog
    source_finding: {phase: p5, register: business_objects, key: Copy barcode registry}
  cross_subdomain_deps:
  - dependency: Read whether a staff member is authorized to perform catalog operations
    direction: catalog → staff
    existing_artifact: ''
    status: GAP
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: authority_deferrals, row: 1}
  pps_artifacts_requiring_action:
  - fqdn: capability_side_effects::CS_MUTABLE_JSON_V0
    current_status: Declared and in use by ai_governance and workload
    action: EXTEND
    source_finding: {phase: p3, register: impact_analysis, key: 'capability_side_effects::CS_MUTABLE_JSON_V0'}
  - fqdn: capability_side_effects::CS_REGISTRY_V0
    current_status: Declared and in use by ai_governance
    action: REUSE
    source_finding: {phase: p3, register: impact_analysis, key: 'capability_side_effects::CS_REGISTRY_V0'}
  - fqdn: capability_side_effects::CS_APPENDONLY_JSONL_V0
    current_status: Declared and in use by ai_governance
    action: REUSE
    source_finding: {phase: p3, register: impact_analysis, key: 'capability_side_effects::CS_APPENDONLY_JSONL_V0'}
  - fqdn: capability_transforms::CT_PURE_ASSEMBLE_RECORD_V0
    current_status: Declared, no current consumer
    action: REUSE
    source_finding: {phase: p3, register: impact_analysis, key: 'capability_transforms::CT_PURE_ASSEMBLE_RECORD_V0'}
  - fqdn: capability_transforms::CT_PURE_VALIDATE_RECORD_STRUCTURE_V0
    current_status: Declared, no current consumer
    action: REUSE
    source_finding: {phase: p3, register: impact_analysis, key: 'capability_transforms::CT_PURE_VALIDATE_RECORD_STRUCTURE_V0'}
  - fqdn: capability_transforms::CT_PURE_FILTER_RECORDS_V0
    current_status: Declared, no current consumer
    action: REUSE
    source_finding: {phase: p3, register: impact_analysis, key: 'capability_transforms::CT_PURE_FILTER_RECORDS_V0'}
  - fqdn: capability_transforms::CT_PURE_VALIDATE_PARAMETER_RULES_V0
    current_status: Declared and in use by ai_governance
    action: REUSE
    source_finding: {phase: p3, register: impact_analysis, key: 'capability_transforms::CT_PURE_VALIDATE_PARAMETER_RULES_V0'}
  boundary_rules:
  - rule_name: CATALOG_OWNS_ITS_STORES
    statement: Every store the catalog reads or writes is declared by the catalog, and no catalog operation writes into a store another subdomain owns.
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: constraint_register, row: 12}
  - rule_name: AUTHORIZATION_IS_READ_NEVER_GRANTED
    statement: The catalog confirms a staff member is authorized on every operation and grants authorization nowhere.
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: design_decisions, row: 8}
  - rule_name: NO_RECORD_IS_DELETED
    statement: No catalog operation removes a record. Retirement is the only way a record leaves use, and it is reversible.
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: business_invariants, row: 9}
  - rule_name: STATE_IS_DATA_ON_THE_RECORD
    statement: A record's registered-or-retired state is held as data on the record, never implied by which store it occupies.
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: design_decisions, row: 4}
  - rule_name: RETIREMENT_NEVER_CASCADES
    statement: Retiring a book leaves its copies untouched and retiring the last copy leaves the book registered; no state change is derived from another.
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: design_decisions, row: 7}
  - rule_name: EVERY_OPERATION_IS_APPENDED
    statement: Every performed catalog operation appends one entry to the catalog's own trail, including searches and retrievals.
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: business_invariants, row: 7}
  - rule_name: READS_RAISE_NO_EVENT
    statement: Searching and retrieving are audited but recognise no business moment, because nothing reacts to a read.
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: design_decisions, row: 5}
  governance_outcome:
  - capability: Register a book together with its first physical copy
    owner_subdomain: catalog
    source_finding: {phase: p6, register: ownership, key: Register a book together with its first physical copy}
  - capability: Register a further physical copy against a registered book
    owner_subdomain: catalog
    source_finding: {phase: p6, register: ownership, key: Register a further physical copy against a registered book}
  - capability: Update a book's bibliographic information
    owner_subdomain: catalog
    source_finding: {phase: p6, register: ownership, key: Update a book's bibliographic information}
  - capability: Retire a book record
    owner_subdomain: catalog
    source_finding: {phase: p6, register: ownership, key: Retire a book record}
  - capability: Retire a physical copy
    owner_subdomain: catalog
    source_finding: {phase: p6, register: ownership, key: Retire a physical copy}
  - capability: Return a retired book record to the registered state
    owner_subdomain: catalog
    source_finding: {phase: p6, register: ownership, key: Return a retired book record to the registered state}
  - capability: Return a retired physical copy to the registered state
    owner_subdomain: catalog
    source_finding: {phase: p6, register: ownership, key: Return a retired physical copy to the registered state}
  - capability: Search the catalog by subject or title
    owner_subdomain: catalog
    source_finding: {phase: p6, register: ownership, key: Search the catalog by subject or title}
  - capability: Retrieve a book's complete details with the copies held
    owner_subdomain: catalog
    source_finding: {phase: p6, register: ownership, key: Retrieve a book's complete details with the copies held}
  - capability: Confirm the staff member performing an operation is authorized
    owner_subdomain: catalog
    source_finding: {phase: p6, register: ownership, key: Confirm the staff member performing an operation is authorized}
  - capability: Record every performed catalog operation in the catalog's own audit trail
    owner_subdomain: catalog
    source_finding: {phase: p6, register: ownership, key: Record every performed catalog operation in the catalog's own audit trail}
```

---

## Domain Placement

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Domain | `book_library_mgmt` |
| Primary subdomain | `catalog` — NEW — declared by this CR |
| Authority class | new actor type: the authorized library staff member |
| Governing constitutions | `fb.constitution::CONSTITUTION_GOVERNANCE_V0`, `fb.topology::CONSTITUTION_WORKFLOW_V0`, `fb.constitution::CONSTITUTION_STRUCTURE_V0` |

The catalog stands alone rather than nesting under an existing subdomain because nothing in the
composition describes what a library holds: there is no boundary to extend, and the nine remaining
project functions do not exist yet to nest beneath. A new actor type is required because the one
business actor in the composition names another subdomain's employee and asserts no authorization to
perform catalog operations.

---

## 1. Subdomain Boundary — Ownership

Eleven capabilities are owned by the catalog and authored by this change. Seven are satisfied by
mechanisms the platform already declares, reused as-is. Two are deferred: one to a function that does
not exist yet, and one that will never exist because a record is never deleted.

---

## 2. Storage Governance Requirements

Every store named here is owned by the catalog and written only by the catalog's own operations.

---

## 3. Cross-Subdomain Dependency Declaration

The catalog reads authorization and never grants it, so the capability that decides who is authorized
is a gap owned by the staff function rather than work this change performs. No catalog operation
writes into a store another subdomain owns, and no capability contract from another subdomain is
called.

---

## 4. PPS Artifacts Requiring Action

Every artifact is read, never modified, so no consumer of any of them is affected by this change.

---

## 5. Governance Boundary Rules

---

## 6. Governance Outcome

---

## gov_projection — Governed Handoff to Stage 7

| Direction | Fields |
|-----------|--------|
| **Consumes** ← Stage 5 | scope_boundary · business_objects · identity_semantics · invariants · actions · provisional_codes · cross_subdomain_refs |
| **Emits** → Stage 7 | ownership · storage_governance · cross_subdomain_deps · pps_artifacts_requiring_action · boundary_rules · governance_outcome |

# Stage 5 — Business Intent: book_library_mgmt / catalog

## Machine

```yaml
document:
  phase: p5
  domain: book_library_mgmt
  subdomain: catalog
  cr: cr_01_catalog
  rule_set: transformation.schemas.REGISTER_SCHEMA_P5_V0
registers:
  subdomain_purpose: |2

    The catalog governs the library's authoritative description of what it holds: one record for each book
    it catalogs, and one for each physical copy it owns. It establishes the authority to state what the
    library has — a book exists in the collection because the catalog says so, and a copy belongs to
    exactly one book because the catalog records it that way. It manages the lifecycle of both records
    from registration through retirement and back, and it records every operation performed against it so
    that any change to the library's description of itself can be traced afterwards. It exists because
    those records are maintained by hand today, which produces inconsistent descriptions, duplicate
    entries and difficulty locating materials. It does not govern who borrows the collection, what is
    ordered, who the library's patrons are, or which staff are authorized.
  purpose_provenance:
  - source: CR seed §0 Subdomain Purpose
    disposition: REFINED
    refinement: States the authority the subdomain establishes — a book exists in the collection because the catalog says so — the lifecycle it manages from registration through retirement and back, and the four functions it explicitly does not govern. The seed states what the catalog is for and why it exists; none of these four additions contradicts it.
  subdomain_purposes:
  - subdomain: catalog
    purpose: Governs the library's authoritative description of what it holds — one record per book it catalogs and one per physical copy it owns — and the lifecycle of both from registration through retirement and back.
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: cr_type, row: 1}
  scope_boundary:
  - capability: Register a book together with its first physical copy
    status: IN_SCOPE
    notes: A book is never registered without a copy
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-05}
  - capability: Register a further physical copy against a registered book
    status: IN_SCOPE
    notes: Refused if the barcode is already owned or the book is not registered
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-06}
  - capability: Update a book's bibliographic information
    status: IN_SCOPE
    notes: Refused if the change would make the book a duplicate of another
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-07}
  - capability: Retire a book record
    status: IN_SCOPE
    notes: Leaves the book's copies untouched
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-08}
  - capability: Retire a physical copy
    status: IN_SCOPE
    notes: Leaves the book record untouched, including when it was the last copy
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-09}
  - capability: Return a retired book record to the registered state
    status: IN_SCOPE
    notes: Reinstatement is explicit, never derived
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-10}
  - capability: Return a retired physical copy to the registered state
    status: IN_SCOPE
    notes: Reinstatement is explicit, never derived
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-11}
  - capability: Search the catalog by subject or title
    status: IN_SCOPE
    notes: Retired books are excluded from results
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-12}
  - capability: Retrieve a book's complete details with the copies held
    status: IN_SCOPE
    notes: Serves retired books as well as registered ones
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-13}
  - capability: Confirm the staff member performing an operation is authorized
    status: IN_SCOPE
    notes: The catalog reads authorization; it never grants it
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-04}
  - capability: Record every performed catalog operation in the catalog's own audit trail
    status: IN_SCOPE
    notes: The catalog owns the trail it appends to
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-01}
  - capability: Read every book record so that a search can select among them by content
    status: IN_SCOPE
    notes: An existing mechanism amended to publish records; owned by platform, not by the catalog
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: authoring_scope, key: GAP-17}
  - capability: Deciding which staff are authorized
    status: DEFERRED
    notes: Belongs to the staff function, which a future change request introduces
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: authority_deferrals, row: 1}
  - capability: Deleting a catalog record
    status: DEFERRED
    notes: 'Not deferred but excluded: a record is never deleted, so no capability is authored for it'
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: business_invariants, row: 9}
  - capability: Importing the records staff maintain manually today
    status: DEFERRED
    notes: The catalog starts empty
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: out_of_scope, key: Import of the records staff maintain manually today}
  - capability: Circulation, patron, staff, reservations, acquisitions, inventory, notifications, policy and reporting
    status: DEFERRED
    notes: The nine remaining project functions, adjacent and untouched
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: governance_scope, row: 2}
  business_objects:
  - store_name: Book record
    record_model: MUTABLE_STATE
    business_rationale: The library requires one authoritative record per book, its bibliographic information is correctable, and its state moves from registered to retired and back on the same record
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: bm_entities, key: Book}
  - store_name: Physical copy record
    record_model: MUTABLE_STATE
    business_rationale: The library requires one authoritative record per copy it owns, and a copy's state moves both ways on the same record
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: bm_entities, key: Physical Copy}
  - store_name: Catalog audit trail
    record_model: APPEND_ONLY_JOURNAL
    business_rationale: Every operation must be traceable afterwards, and a trail that could be amended would not be evidence
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: resources, key: Catalog audit trail}
  - store_name: Book identity registry
    record_model: IDENTITY_REGISTRY
    business_rationale: Duplicate prevention needs an atomic claim on a book's identity at the moment of registration
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: design_decisions, row: 3}
  - store_name: Copy barcode registry
    record_model: IDENTITY_REGISTRY
    business_rationale: No two copies the library owns may share a barcode, and the claim must hold at the moment of registration
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: business_invariants, row: 6}
  identity_semantics:
  - store_name: Book record
    identity_field: Title, author and publication year together
    source: Supplied by the staff member registering the book
    uniqueness_rule: Two registrations carrying the same publication year, and the same title and author without regard to letter case or repeated spacing, describe the same book, and the second is refused
    cross_subdomain_relationship: None
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: identity_and_sameness, row: 1}
  - store_name: Physical copy record
    identity_field: Barcode
    source: Assigned by the library and supplied when the copy is registered
    uniqueness_rule: Two records carrying the same barcode describe the same copy, and the second is refused
    cross_subdomain_relationship: Names exactly one book record
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: identity_and_sameness, row: 2}
  - store_name: Catalog audit trail
    identity_field: Append position
    source: Assigned when the entry is appended
    uniqueness_rule: Each performed operation appends exactly one entry, and no entry is amended or removed
    cross_subdomain_relationship: Names the staff member who performed the operation
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: resources, key: Catalog audit trail}
  - store_name: Book identity registry
    identity_field: The key formed from title, author and publication year
    source: Formed by the catalog, comparing title and author without regard to letter case or repeated spacing
    uniqueness_rule: The key is claimed once; a second claim on it fails and the registration is refused
    cross_subdomain_relationship: None
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: design_decisions, row: 3}
  - store_name: Copy barcode registry
    identity_field: Barcode
    source: Assigned by the library
    uniqueness_rule: The barcode is claimed once; a second claim on it fails and the copy registration is refused
    cross_subdomain_relationship: None
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: business_invariants, row: 6}
  invariants:
  - invariant: Each physical copy belongs to exactly one book
    business_reason: A copy the library owns is a copy of one published thing; a copy recorded against two books would make the collection's description untrue
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: business_invariants, row: 1}
  - invariant: Each book the library holds has exactly one authoritative record
    business_reason: The library needs one place that says what it holds, which is the whole point of a governed catalog
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: business_invariants, row: 2}
  - invariant: Each physical copy the library owns has exactly one authoritative record
    business_reason: Two records for one copy would make the library's count of what it owns unreliable
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: business_invariants, row: 3}
  - invariant: No two registered books share the same title, author and publication year
    business_reason: Duplicate entries are the pain this change exists to remove
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: business_invariants, row: 4}
  - invariant: A book carries at least one subject
    business_reason: Subject is what staff search on when looking for material rather than a known title, so a book with none could not be found that way
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: business_invariants, row: 5}
  - invariant: No two physical copies the library owns share the same barcode
    business_reason: A barcode is how staff name one copy among several of the same book, including when retiring one
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: business_invariants, row: 6}
  - invariant: Every business operation performed against the catalog is traceable and auditable
    business_reason: The library must be able to account afterwards for every change to its description of itself
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: business_invariants, row: 7}
  - invariant: Only authorized staff perform catalog operations
    business_reason: The catalog is the library's authoritative record, and an unauthorized change to it would not be authoritative
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: business_invariants, row: 8}
  - invariant: No catalog record is ever deleted
    business_reason: Retirement is the only way a record leaves use; a deleted record would leave its audit trail pointing at nothing
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: business_invariants, row: 9}
  - invariant: A registered book always has at the moment of registration at least one physical copy
    business_reason: The library catalogs what it holds, and a book it holds no copy of is not a holding
    source_finding: {phase: p1, register: operation_refusals, row: 2}
  actions:
  - action: Register
    object: Book, with its first physical copy
    trigger: An authorized staff member registers a book the library has acquired
    status: IN_SCOPE
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: capability_graph, key: Register a book together with its first physical copy}
  - action: Register
    object: Physical copy
    trigger: An authorized staff member records a further copy of a registered book
    status: IN_SCOPE
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: capability_graph, key: Register a further physical copy against a registered book}
  - action: Update
    object: Book's bibliographic information
    trigger: An authorized staff member corrects or changes a book's description
    status: IN_SCOPE
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: capability_graph, key: Update a book's bibliographic information}
  - action: Retire
    object: Book record
    trigger: An authorized staff member judges the record obsolete
    status: IN_SCOPE
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: capability_graph, key: Retire a book record}
  - action: Retire
    object: Physical copy
    trigger: A copy is lost or damaged
    status: IN_SCOPE
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: capability_graph, key: Retire a physical copy}
  - action: Reinstate
    object: Book record
    trigger: An authorized staff member returns a retired book to use
    status: IN_SCOPE
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: capability_graph, key: Return a retired book record to the registered state}
  - action: Reinstate
    object: Physical copy
    trigger: An authorized staff member returns a retired copy to use
    status: IN_SCOPE
    source_finding: {phase: p4, register: capability_graph, key: Return a retired physical copy to the registered state}
```

## 3. Business Objects

No record is ever deleted. Retirement is the only way a record leaves use, and it is reversible, which
is why both record stores hold state as data rather than by which store a record occupies.

## 8. Cross-Subdomain References

No capability contract from another subdomain is referenced. The catalog reuses declared mechanisms —
durable records, uniqueness, an append-only trail and four pure transforms — and composes them itself,
so that no catalog operation depends on another subdomain's semantics or writes into its stores.

```yaml
  - criterion: Every catalog operation performed can be traced and audited afterwards.
  identity_and_sameness:
  - business_object: Book
    identified_by: Its title, author and publication year together.
    two_are_the_same_when: Their publication year matches and their titles and authors match without regard to letter case or repeated spacing.
  - business_object: Physical Copy
    identified_by: The barcode the library assigns to it.
    two_are_the_same_when: Their barcodes match.
  lifecycle_transitions:
  - object: Book
    from_state: null
    to_state: Registered
    triggered_by: Authorized staff register the book together with its first physical copy.
    cascade: None beyond the first copy being registered with it.
  - object: Book
    from_state: Registered
    to_state: Retired
    triggered_by: Authorized staff judge the record obsolete and retire it.
    cascade: None — the book's physical copies are unaffected.
  - object: Book
    from_state: Retired
    to_state: Registered
    triggered_by: Authorized staff return the retired book record to the registered state.
    cascade: None — the book's physical copies are unaffected.
  - object: Physical Copy
    from_state: null
    to_state: Registered
    triggered_by: Authorized staff register the copy against a registered book.
    cascade: None.
  - object: Physical Copy
    from_state: Registered
    to_state: Retired
    triggered_by: Authorized staff retire a copy that is lost or damaged.
    cascade: None — the book record is unaffected, including when it is the last copy.
  - object: Physical Copy
    from_state: Retired
    to_state: Registered
    triggered_by: Authorized staff return the retired copy to the registered state.
    cascade: None — the book record is unaffected.
  operation_refusals:
  - operation: Register a book
    refused_when: Its title, author and publication year match a registered book.
    business_reason: The catalog holds one record per book; the book already exists, and a further copy is what staff register instead.
  - operation: Register a book
    refused_when: No physical copy is offered with it.
    business_reason: A book is never registered without at least one copy.
  - operation: Register a book
    refused_when: It carries no subject.
    business_reason: A book carries at least one subject, and subject is what staff search on.
  - operation: Register a physical copy
    refused_when: The book it names is not registered.
    business_reason: Each physical copy belongs to exactly one book.
  - operation: Register a physical copy
    refused_when: Its barcode matches a copy the library already owns.
    business_reason: A barcode identifies one copy; no two copies share one.
  - operation: Update bibliographic information
    refused_when: The changed title, author and publication year would match another registered book.
    business_reason: Title, author and publication year identify a book; an update must not make one book a duplicate of another.
  - operation: Any catalog operation
    refused_when: The staff member performing it is not authorized.
    business_reason: Only authorized staff may perform catalog operations.
  authority_deferrals:
  - business_object: Which staff are authorized
    deferred_to: The staff function, which governs library employees
    until: A future governed change request introduces the staff function.
```
